LESSON: HISTORIC BUILT ENVIRONMENTS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.5: Historic Built Environments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Historic Built Environments
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should we conserve the historic built environments?
